title: Observation
description: A single observed event, extracted from telemetry, describing what happened under some trigger context and its outcome. The trigger is intentionally opaque -- this package must never assume its internal shape beyond exact-equality comparison.

project_id.description: The scope this observation belongs to.

pattern.description: An open, illustrative classification of what was observed, e.g. 'recurrent-failure', 'successful-recovery', 'correction', 'workflow-efficiency' -- not a fixed enum.

trigger.description: An intentionally opaque match context, e.g. {"node_id": ..., "failure_class": ...}; this package must never assume its internal shape beyond exact-equality comparison.

source_event_ids.description: Exact telemetry-record ids, never a paraphrase.

confidence.description: An optional per-observation confidence the extractor may attach, distinct from the aggregate heuristic-level confidence.
